result:
Comment authors can now edit their own comments. I didn't run tests, lint or the app, so none of this has been run or type-checked.

- **API:** `features/comments/api/update-comment.ts` sends `PATCH /comments/{commentId}` with the new body. It validates the body with Zod, refreshes the comments list after saving, and shows a "Comment Updated" success notification.
- **Notification placement:** `src/features/CLAUDE.md` says success notifications belong in the mutation hook under `api/`, so the notification is in `useUpdateComment` rather than the component. The existing create and delete components do it the other way, and I left them alone.
- **Edit button:** `features/comments/components/update-comment.tsx` adds an Edit button that opens a form drawer pre-filled with the current body.
- **Own comments only:** I added a `comment:update` policy in `lib/authorization.tsx` that is true only when the user is the comment's author. Admins can delete any comment but can't edit others' comments. `comments-list.tsx` wraps the Edit button in that policy, next to the existing Delete button.
- **Mock handler:** I added a PATCH handler to the MSW comments handlers so the endpoint works in dev and tests. It only updates the comment if the logged-in user is its author.
